versions.notes: Download of the 3D simulator 3D-1.4: it starts without sending; the switch «An Motion Watch senden» in its window turns sending on.

Tools page redesigned, calmer: list of the tools on the left (with status), one tool at a time on the right; on a phone first the list, then the tool with a back button. Plain line icons, switches instead of check boxes, no empty boxes.
The 3D simulator for Windows can be downloaded from the Pi: /sim/simulator3d.zip (button under Simulator → Tools).

Second Wi-Fi adapter (USB stick): repeater (own Wi-Fi + internet from another network at the same time), change to another known network when the internet is gone, push message when it is back, devices in the own Wi-Fi without internet, Wi-Fi guard (alarm on jamming / deauthentication, needs a stick that can listen), adapter list with chip and abilities. Tools page tidied up: groups, every tool folds up and shows its last result. Fix: the Wi-Fi search of the settings works again.

New page "Tools": network scanner (makers, names, warning about new devices, "am I at home" with automatic arming), Wi-Fi surroundings with the best channel, internet test, security check, Bluetooth scanner with tracker warning, focus assistant, servo test, loudspeaker / microphone test, memory card test, diagnosis package without secrets, power calculator.
System: size of the project (program file, lines, data, settings, recordings, simulator), running time, memory, Python version, Pi model and operating system.

simulator section tidied up: status with statistics (connected for, response time, camera / thermal pictures per second, messages, sensor events, errors), «Simulators in the network» with «Search now» (asks every address of the own network, progress and result), per simulator: seen since, last message, number of messages, response time; settings and tools folded away.

simulators are found by themselves: every simulator announces itself every 2 s (UDP 8764), Motion Watch lists them («Use») and - with «find by itself» on and no working connection - takes over the address (a PC before the Pi); simulator requests never go through a proxy.

page /preview: the web page as on a phone or a tablet, upright or across, with or without full screen (button in the simulators and in the simulator section); the page may be shown in a frame of its own origin only (SAMEORIGIN).
the quick switches below the joystick can be chosen and arranged («Arrange» tile: tick, ▲ ▼, reset) - web page and window; the viewer count moved to the right in the header.
